_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Local User', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "view_style" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'list', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "order_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_collapsed" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "due_json" TEXT NULL, "deadline_json" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "estimated_focus_intervals" INTEGER NULL, "completed_focus_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_focus_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "order_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_order" INTEGER NULL, "is_collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_collapsed" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "order_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_labels" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "label_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "filters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "query" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "order_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "spec_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "short_break_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "long_break_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intervals_before_long_break" INTEGER NOT NULL, "auto_start_breaks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_start_breaks" IN (0, 1)), "auto_start_work" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_start_work" IN (0, 1)), "allow_pause" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("allow_pause" IN (0, 1)), "strict_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("strict_mode" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL, "preset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "target_work_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_work_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_intervals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, "paused_total_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "stopped_at" INTEGER NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_daily_stats" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_tasks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_focus_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_focus_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "interrupted_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "planned_focus_intervals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "calculated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_commands" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_pulled_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_pushed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "google_calendar_connections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_email" TEXT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NULL, "owner_device_id" TEXT NULL, "calendar_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pomodoist', "sync_token" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disconnected', "last_error" TEXT NULL, "warning" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_sync_finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "google_calendar_event_links" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "google_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_synced_local_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "unsupported_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "id_mappings" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id", "entity_type"));
